description: This file is a PHP source file implementing a wrapper for the FogBugz API, including classes for API interaction, CURL handling, and custom exceptions. It defines the main class 'FogBugz' for interfacing with FogBugz, a supporting class 'FogBugzCurl' for HTTP requests, and several exception classes.

classes.name: FogBugz
classes.description: Main class for interfacing with the FogBugz API, handling authentication, requests, and session management.

classes.name: FogBugzCurl
classes.description: Helper class that encapsulates CURL HTTP requests with predefined settings.

classes.name: FogBugzCurlError
classes.description: Exception class for errors related to Curl operations.

classes.name: FogBugzAPIError
classes.description: General exception class for API errors.

classes.name: FogBugzLogonError
classes.description: Exception class for login-specific errors, extending FogBugzAPIError.

classes.name: FogBugzConnectionError
classes.description: Exception class for connection errors, extending FogBugzAPIError.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the FogBugz class, initializes properties and CURL object.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor for the FogBugz class, logs off if necessary.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic API command calls, forwarding them internally.

methods.name: logon
methods.description: Logs into FogBugz API and stores the authentication token.

methods.name: logoff
methods.description: Logs off from FogBugz API and resets the token.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Internal method to send requests to FogBugz API and process XML response.
